comment: This is a suitable framing.We support continuing engagement with partners within and outside the government to align all contributions within the national architecture. However, we note that we have not yet seen a country trainsition from from primarily donor-to-domestic financing for their DPI-H.  Such a dynamic limits full country ownership and, long-term, the sustainability of open source digital public goods which compose DPI-H.
